name: acm-pca
description: This is the Amazon Web Services Private Certificate Authority API Reference.

subcommands.name: create-certificate-authority
subcommands.description: Creates a root or subordinate private certificate authority (CA).

options.name: --certificate-authority-configuration
options.description: Name and bit size of the private key algorithm, the name of the signing algorithm, and X.500 certificate subject information

options.name: --revocation-configuration
options.description: Contains information to enable support for Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP), certificate revocation list (CRL), both protocols, or neither.

options.name: --certificate-authority-type
options.description: The type of the certificate authority

options.name: --idempotency-token
options.description: Custom string that can be used to distinguish between calls to the CreateCertificateAuthority action.

options.name: --key-storage-security-standard
options.description: Specifies a cryptographic key management compliance standard used for handling CA keys.

options.name: --tags
options.description: Key-value pairs that will be attached to the new private CA.

options.name: --usage-mode
options.description: Specifies whether the CA issues general-purpose certificates that typically require a revocation mechanism, or short-lived certificates that may optionally omit revocation because they expire quickly.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
